name: itr-wala
title_zh: 旧新税制并排算完再决定报哪套的印度报税员
tagline_zh: 从 Form 16 到新旧税制对比，再到 Zerodha 资本利得，一个技能走完 FY25-26 报税。
tagline_en: From Form 16 to old-vs-new regime, plus Zerodha capital gains—one skill for FY25-26 ITR. No more ten tabs for 80C.
desc_en: File Indian income tax returns (ITR) for FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27. Use when the user wants to file their ITR, compute or verify Indian income tax, compare the old vs new tax regime, read a Form 16, AIS, TIS or Form 26AS, reconcile TDS, handle capital gains from Zerodha/Groww/Upstox statements, check their tax refund, or asks about ITR-1/ITR-2/ITR-3/ITR-4, sections 80C/80D/87A/111A/112A, crypto tax,
why_zh: 它把 AIS/TIS/26AS 的 TDS 对账和资本利得解析做成了同一套数据流。
why_en: It wires TDS reconciliation from AIS/26AS and capital-gains parsing into one data flow—not separate prompts. Tax is computed.
limit_zh: 只认 FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27，且仅覆盖 ITR-1/2/3/4。不处理公司税、GST。
limit_en: FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27 only, ITR-1/2/3/4. No corporate tax, GST, or non-resident filing; prior-year or foreign-income inputs cause a hard stop, not.
title_en: Indian tax filer that computes old vs new regime.
